Section 2. Changes for 2027
Do not rely only on these change descriptions; this Section is not an official statement of benefits. For that, go to Section 5 (Benefits).
Also, we edited and clarified language throughout the brochure; any language change not shown here is a clarification that does not
change benefits.
Changes to our FEPBlue Focus
• We will no longer provide 8 over-the-counter (OTC) COVID-19 tests per member.
• For Self Only contracts, the calendar year deductible is now $1,000. For Self Plus One, and Self and Family contracts, the
deductible is now $2,000 (see page 27).
• For Self Only contracts, your Preferred Provider catastrophic out-of-pocket maximum is now $11,000. For Self Plus One and Self
and Family contracts, your Preferred Provider catastrophic out-of-pocket maximum is now $22,000 (see page 29).
• Your copayment for maternity services billed by a Preferred facility is now $3,000 per pregnancy (see page 63).
• For members enrolled in our regular pharmacy drug program, Tier 3 Preferred Specialty Drugs purchased at a Preferred retail
pharmacy and through the Specialty Drug Pharmacy Program (generic and brand name) you are now responsible for 40% of the
Plan allowance (up to the maximum of $600) for a 30-day supply and 40% of the Plan allowance (up to a maximum of $1,700) for
31 to 90-day supply (see page 86).
• Members who elect to receive electronic explanation of benefits (EOBs) will receive a $10 credit to their health account (see page
94).
